criteria.quote: Rhydon's brain developed after it stood on two legs.
criteria.revision: Make the first line juxtapose the brain development with the contradiction: "Rhydon's brain developed when it stood up—yet it is very forgetful." Both claims are explicitly supported by the Pokédex.

criteria.quote: Standing frees its forelegs, and the Pokédex says it gets smarter.
How can Rhydon become smarter, yet remain very forgetful?
criteria.revision: Sharpen the open loop into a direct evidence-based contradiction: "If standing made Rhydon smarter, why does the same Pokédex call it very forgetful?"

criteria.quote: Rhydon evolves from Rhyhorn before this posture change begins.
criteria.revision: Merge the evolution setup with the causal reveal instead of spending separate beats on chronology: "After evolving from Rhyhorn, Rhydon begins walking on its hind legs—and the Pokédex says standing freed its forelegs and made it smarter." Then reserve the forgetfulness reveal for the escalation.

criteria.quote: Yet one Pokédex entry still calls Rhydon very forgetful.
criteria.revision: Make the reversal more abrupt and specific: "Then the same Pokédex adds: Rhydon is very forgetful."

Reduce the repeated standing/brain beats by making each one perform a different function: establish the unusual claim, give the documented mechanism—"Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs"—then reveal the separate description that Rhydon is "very forgetful."

criteria.quote: The final picture is a contradiction: a developed brain paired with a very forgetful Rhydon.
criteria.revision: End with the exact contrast as a final reframing rather than merely labeling it a contradiction: "Rhydon’s brain developed after it stood up. Standing freed its forelegs and made it smarter—but the Pokédex still calls it very forgetful."

criteria.quote: Which matters more, Rhydon's smarter brain or its forgetfulness?
criteria.revision: Make the closing question a clearer interpretive split grounded in the entries: "Does ‘made it smarter’ still describe intelligence if Rhydon is also called very forgetful?"
